root=Path('/home/amirreza/Desktop/Projects/Attestara')
def read(p):return json.loads((root/p).read_text())
p=read('docs/evidence/C05.json');assert p['passed']
for name,want in p['source_files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==want,name
identity='sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(''.join(n+'\0'+h+'\n' for n,h in p['source_files'].items()).encode()).hexdigest();assert identity==p['source_identity']
actual=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines())|set(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines())
assert actual==set(p['changed_paths']),(actual-set(p['changed_paths']),set(p['changed_paths'])-actual)
for name in actual:
 path=Path(name);assert not path.name.startswith(('.env','Dockerfile')) and 'migrations' not in path.parts,name
 data=(root/name).read_bytes();assert data.endswith(b'\n'),name
 for line in data.splitlines():assert line.rstrip(b' \t')==line,name
old=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:plans/roadmap.json'],cwd=root,text=True));new=read('plans/roadmap.json')
assert [a['id'] for a,b in zip(old['commits'],new['commits']) if a!=b]==['C05']
assert {k:v for k,v in old.items() if k!='commits'}=={k:v for k,v in new.items() if k!='commits'}
oldproof=read('docs/evidence/C04.json')
for n,h in oldproof['source_files'].items():
 if n.startswith(('internal/contracts/','tests/fixtures/attestara/C04/')):assert hashlib.sha256((root/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,n
progress=next(x for x in read('plans/progress.json')['commits'] if x['id']=='C05');assert progress['status']=='verified' and progress['source_identity']==identity
assert read('plans/project-state.json')['core_ready'] is False and read('plans/project-state.json')['next_task']=='C06'
assert read('docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json')['final_source_identity']==identity
assert next(x for x in read('apps/web/src/generated/project.json')['tasks'] if x['id']=='C05')['status']=='verified'
assert all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in p['commands'])
print('C05 source hashes and identity match all',len(p['source_files']),'listed source files.')
print('Changed-path inventory matches all',len(actual),'files; no protected paths, trailing whitespace or missing final newlines.')
print('Only C05 roadmap task changed; C04 contract code and fixtures preserved; progress/handoff/projection agree; core_ready=false; next=C06.')
